sentences.text: Tienosuchus is a dubious, monospecific genus of gavialoid crocodilian.
Only one fossil occurrence of Tienosuchus has been recorded.
The genus was named by Young in 1949, with the type species Tienosuchus hsiangi also described that year.

It is closely related to the genus Thoracosaurus and was traditionally placed in the subfamily Thoracosaurinae, though this group is now considered a paraphyletic assemblage of basal gavialoids rather than a true clade.
Fossils of this animal date to the Eocene epoch, living between 56 and 48.07 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
